summary: Merge of main (d78e2c4, carrying #532) into the #533 branch, commit 1b93ced. Faithful: #532's tamperSignature(t, tok, at), TestValidateAccessToken_Tampered, _ForgedPayload and the imports are byte-identical to main; the PR's cast-token test is the reviewed d3f0207 version with its helper renamed flipSignatureBit and one accurate doc-comment clause added; nothing else in the tree differs from main. go build/vet/test -count=1 ./... pass; the four tamper/forged tests pass 300x and 50x under -race; 4,000-token helper sweeps clean. 20 mutants x 40 runs: the cast test kills every partial-compare mutant except text-prefix, case-insensitive and XOR-checksum (known lows). Low: the PR description's line about TestValidateAccessToken_Tampered is stale after #532. Informational, pre-existing on main: #532's access tests miss a minlen compare (empty signature forges any access token) and a first-and-last-byte compare; the cast test's cases would catch both.
